opening.argument: The title presents a Onecoin-branded opportunity as an official and legal way to make money, while directing viewers toward an external link: “Now is the time to make MONEY! Officially! Legally!” The speaker then urges newcomers to participate, stating, “If you are new to Vangoin, I recommend you to try it!” That recommendation is paired with an easy-wealth representation, “because millions are made here.” The material therefore promotes participation in the associated service and suggests that viewers’ lives could improve through the opportunity, without explaining a legitimate product or substantiating how those claimed earnings are produced.
